title: Probing the Rare Four-Bottom Higgs Decay $H\to b\bar b b\bar b$ at the HL-LHC and ILC
summary: We propose the rare SM Higgs decay $H\to b\bar b b\bar b$ as a probe of the structure of Higgs interactions with bottom quarks and gauge bosons, and as a baseline for searches for new physics producing four-bottom final states in Higgs decays. We compute the leading contributions to this decay, including the dominant $H\to b\bar b g\to b\bar b b\bar b$ topology, the sizeable $H\to ZZ^\ast\to b\bar b b\bar b$ channel, and the loop-induced $H\to gg\to b\bar b b\bar b$ contribution.
